story: On a sunny Sunday morning at 11:17, with the Florida air holding steady at 77 degrees, Gary, Donna, and Rosa all make their way out onto Magnolia Loop. Donna walks out full of energy, while Gary heads over with patient hope and Rosa with easy contentment. Hal, the watchful one, has taken up his post on the street, quietly counting the pink flamingos in Donna's flock.
events: Gary headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).
Donna headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).
Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos visible from the street and note it in my head
Rosa headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).

gary.thought_process: I've been bench-testing and dry-fitting everything indoors for a few ticks, and the work is mostly done. Rosa pointed out the Architectural Review sign-off isn't in yet, and L-01 says nothing visible from the street goes on the cart until it is. The application was filed at tick 156, so the next move is checking where it stands. It's Sunday, and the parade is Saturday, so I don't have unlimited time. I'll head out to Magnolia Loop, see what's posted on the bulletin board, and be a good neighbor while I'm at it. The cart stays in the garage until approval comes through.

parameters.content: Heading out to the Loop to check the bulletin board for word on my review application while the cart stays put in the garage.

donna.thought_process: I've packed the bag, penciled in the practice slot and ladder match, and texted Gary already. Everything is organized. Nobody is nearby, and it's a sunny Sunday morning, so sitting around the house won't climb the ladder. Time to head out to Magnolia Loop, catch Gary or run into neighbors, and get some social chair business done for Halloween on the Loop.

parameters.content: Everything's packed and penciled in, so I'm heading out onto the Loop to find Gary and see who's out for Halloween planning.

hal.thought_process: I'm on Magnolia Loop at 11:17 on a quiet Sunday morning. Halloween decor is permitted all week, so I'm not about to cite anybody for pumpkins. But Donna's flamingo flock is right here in the zone, and L-02 caps ornaments visible from the street at three. A proper count is due before anything goes to the committee. Facts first, grumbling after.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos visible from the street and note it in my head

rosa.thought_process: The dinner went well and the table is cleared. I've checked my shift schedule twice now, so I don't need to look at it again. It's a quiet sunny Sunday morning and nobody is around. The Halloween flyer is up, and the cart parade and costume contest are Saturday. A walk out to Magnolia Loop would let me see what decorations are going up and maybe catch a neighbor to follow up on the dinner.

parameters.content: Taking a stroll out to the Loop to see how the Halloween decorating is coming along and say hello to whoever's out.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
